text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!!? I-It's heeereeeee!? 
Dia-chan, runnnn!!" || "Eeeek!!? I-It's 
heeereeeee!? 
Dia-chan, ruuuuun!!

text_block_list.name: Leaf-Covered Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Visitors, after all this time...! Welcome, 
welcome, thank you for coming. 
Hohoho... foah?! NOOOOOO...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Hyah! ...Are you okay?! 
Waaaah! A-A-Are you all right?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you are the shrine's head priest. 
I had thought...! Well, in any case, I'm 
glad you're not hurt.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You really surprised us~! Appearing 
covered in fallen leaves like that! 
Um... is this, like, a long-overdue grand 
cleanup?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I actually sweep every day... but 
the grounds are far too large for an old 
man. 
I'm ashamed to show you such a dilapidated 
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And surely you have duties beyond just 
cleaning... 
Could it be that you are running this 
place entirely on your own?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, indeed. Back in my younger days I 
was a 'powerful hunk', so I managed it all 
by myself just fine~.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
But... things can't stay as they were 
forever. Age catches up to us all. 
In the past, the neighbors would come for 
Hatsumode, and the sacred rituals were so 
lively, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Priest-san. You've been protecting this 
shrine all this time, haven't you...? 
...Hey, Dia-chan. You know...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what is it? 
Although, I can already guess what you're 
thinking♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: TAAAAAHHHHHHHH-------!!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... the leaves are flying at incredible 
speed...! 
Umamusume truly are vigorous and strong~~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's our neighborhood helper captain, 
Kita-chan, for you♪ Alright, me too! 
Priest-san, could you lend me some tools 
for weeding?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you've done more than enough. 
I can't possibly let you work for free...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, this is nothing. 
It would be such a waste to leave such a 
wonderful shrine like this, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's fix it up nice and clean, and invite 
lots of visitors for Hatsumode! 
We'll call it... 'Operation Shrine 
Revival'!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Besides, 'kindness is never wasted.' 
My dad always says we should help each 
other when times are tough.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Thank you so, so much. 
Ah, I know, take some persimmons from the 
mountain out back! I have enough to sell~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you sure? Ehehe, thank you so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's a huge haul of persimmons. Did we 
end up making him feel obligated...? 
No, the priest was totally getting into 
the groove of things, wasn't he...?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
He was definitely in high spirits! 
He's such an energetic elderly 
gentleman... Fufufufu.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right! Ah... Dia-chan, um. 
We did say we'd 'take it easy during New 
Year's', but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, I'm having fun too. 
And I'm sure everyone will be thrilled. 
Let's do our best, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan... Yeah! Let's do our best 
together! 
We're definitely gonna make this New 
Year's super lively--!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
First up is spreading the word! 
*deep breath*... Everrryone~! Please come 
visit this shrine for Hatsumode☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what's this? Huh, there's a shrine 
like that nearby? 
Maybe I'll invite the others staying 
behind at the dorm and go check it out~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hatsumode, huh~! Ooh~, a shrine like 
this... Maybe I'll go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Senpais! Thanks for your hard work. 
Oh, that's right, both of you are staying 
at the academy for training adjustments 
this year!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, I have heard of this shrine. 
If I recall correctly, it is said to have 
a wonderful, refined atmosphere... Why are 
the two of you promoting it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, the thing is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To think that happened...! Ah! So that's 
where the 'Help Yourself' persimmons 
in the Ritto Dorm kitchen came from...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Spe-chan did say, 'They were so 
delicious, I ate a whole bunch.' 
Taking full advantage of everyone being 
away visiting family...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-There really was a whole mountain of 
them, I swear~! 
I properly saved enough for everyone else, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two. If it's alright, would you 
let me help out as well? 
I'd really love to repay the favor for 
those delicious persimmons!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Really? Wow, that's a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, I would like to help as 
well. 
I have always held an interest in shrine 
events, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
With the two of you, that's a hundred 
horsepower. 
It's very reassuring♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmmmmm, I was wondering what you two 
were up to. 
Helping out at a shrine, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you keep something so interesting to 
yourselves! Listen up, 
ancient places are steeped in magical 
power, you know? Count me in too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Sweep-san, you'll help too? 
Thank you~, you're more than welcome!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sweep-san! It's been a while! 
Fufufu, 'Caro Caro, Caromia'~?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
'Turn super stylish~!' 
Wait, ahahaha! You liked that spell that 
much~?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because it rolls off the tongue so nicely 
and it's so fun! 
Whenever I chant it in the morning, I feel 
like my hairstyle turns out just right!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? I knew you had potential. 
You're building up magical power♪ Must be 
the result of your training at the 
amusement park!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Amusement park...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Remember when I told you about that 
fashion magazine photoshoot—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We were both pretty nervous at first... 
but by the end of it, we'd really opened 
up and just couldn't stop chatting!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, one of the staff members gave 
us tickets to the amusement park. And 
then, at the exact same time, we both 
went, "Let's go today!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's only natural we get along. She 
is your childhood friend, after all, 
Kita-san♪ I always knew she was something 
special!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so! You two really hit it off, 
huh? I had no idea...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I knew everything about 
Dia-chan, but... Well, a lot of things 
have happened to me too since enrolling 
here...)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah, no, it's nothing! ...Ahaha, wait 
up, you two~!
